title: JRHMS Recruitment 2026 – Specialist Medical Officer Posts
shortInfo: JRHMS has announced notification for Specialist Medical Officer posts. Required qualification: MBBS, PG Degree/Diploma in various fields. Last date to apply: 31-10-26.

dates.event: Opening of Online Application
Last Date for Submission of Online Application
Cut-off Date for Age

howToApply: Eligible candidates shall apply online through the prescribed recruitment portal: www.recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in
Applications shall be accepted only through the online mode. No application submitted by post, e-mail, hand delivery or any other mode shall be entertained.
Candidates shall carefully fill in all mandatory fields marked with an asterisk (*) and shall ensure that all information furnished is correct and complete.
The application shall be treated as successfully submitted only when the portal displays the status ‘Submitted Successfully’.
Incomplete, defective or partially filled applications shall be liable to rejection.
A candidate shall not submit more than one application for the same post. Multiple/duplicate applications may lead to cancellation of candidature.
No request for change/correction of information shall ordinarily be entertained after final submission of the online application.
A candidate may submit bids for a maximum of three facilities in one application form.
The candidate shall quote the monthly remuneration separately for each selected facility. The quoted monthly amount shall not exceed ₹3,00,000/- per month.
Ensure that the application fee, wherever prescribed in the portal, is paid and the application is finally submitted within the stipulated time.

howToApply: Visit the official recruitment portal: www.recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in
Register and fill in all mandatory fields marked with an asterisk (*) carefully.

Upload all required documents including photograph, signature, educational certificates, experience certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), and Medical Council Registration Certificate.
Submit the financial bid for a maximum of three facilities, quoting monthly remuneration (not exceeding ₹3,00,000/- per month) for each selected facility.
Pay the application fee wherever prescribed on the portal.
Submit the application before 31/10/2026 at 11:59 PM. The application is successfully submitted only when the portal displays ‘Submitted Successfully’.
Do not submit more than one application for the same post.

howToApply: Candidates must appear for Walk-in-Interview/Test at CSIR-NML, Burmamines, Jamshedpur-831007 (Jharkhand) on the scheduled date as per the group/project.
Report between 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM on the respective date (06.10.2026, 07.10.2026, 08.10.2026, or 09.10.2026).
Fill in the prescribed Application Form (PROFORMA) with a recent colour passport size photograph pasted on it.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant testimonials/certificates (educational, experience, community, Aadhaar, PAN, etc.).
Bring all original certificates/documents for verification on the day of the Walk-in-Interview.
A separate application form is required for each Group.
No other mode of application (online/postal) will be entertained.
Final semester/year students awaiting results are NOT eligible.
Candidates who have already been engaged in CSIR-NML or any other CSIR Lab/Institute as Project Staff for 6 years or more are NOT eligible.

howToApply: Visit the official JSSC website: https://jssc.jharkhand.gov.in/
Click on “Online Application for JTAACCE-2026 (Para Teacher)” and complete registration.
Note down the registration number and password sent via SMS/email.

Log in again and fill in complete personal, educational, and category details; save and continue through each page. Select whether you are applying for the regular vacancy (04/2026), backlog vacancy (05/2026), or both.
Pay the exam fee online after logging in again the next day (post 12:00 noon). Only one fee is payable even if applying for both advertisements.
One day after fee payment, log in again to upload your scanned photograph and signature.
Verify all details, submit the form, and take a printout for future reference.
